recentItems.title: 🇨🇳 HIT FM - Aircheck: October 19, 2025 | English CHR station in China
recentItems.description:
JOIN THE BROADCAST PLAZA DISCORD TODAY! "THIS IS THE PLACE" FOR ALL THINGS BROADCASTING: bit.ly/Emarsee

A look at HIT FM, an English language contemporary hit radio network broadcasting in Shanghai on 87.9 FM and Beijing on 88.7 FM. The station is owned by China Radio International, a part of China Media Group and controlled by the Chinese government as state media. 

The network first signed on in 1999 and previously had coverage in other cities in China like Guangzhou and Chengdu, but have since shut down. 

In 2023, a directive came from the National Radio and Television Administration to "streamline operations" of the country's radio and television operations due to declining revenue and listenership. Since then, various radio stations across the country have been taken off air.

CRI's HIT FM and EZ FM (an English/Chinese adult contemporary and talk station) were taken off the air on December 23, 2025. The last song on Hit FM as "Good Time" by Owl City and Carly Rae Jepsen.
In Beijing, the frequency was taken off the air completely; while in Shanghai, 87.9 FM became a simulcast of CGTN Radio, an English language news/talk station. 

Listeners of HIT FM were encouraged to listen to China National Radio's "Music Radio" streaming service. 

I recorded this in Shanghai during my trip with a Qodosen DX-286. HIT FM mostly ran hostless but did have a host for their weekly countdown show on Sunday (which I did not record). 

Complete aircheck: https://archive.org/details/hitfm-china-aircheck
